findings.message: The recovery marker is read with `File.ReadAllTextAsync` without a size limit, then deserialized. A marker file in the retained worktree can therefore force unbounded memory use when a later claim tries recovery. Enforce a byte limit before reading and refuse oversized markers.
findings.evidenceChecked: `TryResumePushProtectionAsync` reads `PushProtectionMarkerPath` and parses the full text; marker writes use `JsonSerializer.Serialize` but no corresponding read bound is present.
findings.missing: A maximum marker size enforced before reading/deserialization.

findings.message: `ParseGitHubRejection` splits and scans the complete stderr string with no size or line-count bound. A remote-controlled rejection response can drive unbounded allocation and parsing work. Bound the captured rejection size and refuse oversized input.
findings.evidenceChecked: The method accepts caller-provided stderr, splits all of it into lines, and runs pattern matching across every line; no limit is enforced in this code.
findings.missing: A validated maximum stderr size or bounded line-processing limit.
